subject.title: [Feature]: Sessions page polish: dot + label status, Runtime column into the row drawer

question: Should the Sessions page move to the proposed dot-plus-label status treatment and hide the Runtime column in favor of drawer details?
rationale: This is user-visible Control UI polish on a protected maintainer-labeled issue, and the desired visual density tradeoff is a product decision rather than a broken existing contract.

options.title: Accept the focused polish
options.body: Implement the requested Sessions roster and drawer changes in the existing Control UI view, style, and tests.

options.title: Narrow the change
options.body: Keep the status restyle or the Runtime move, but defer the other part if maintainers want a smaller visual adjustment.

options.title: Defer the polish
options.body: Leave the current redesigned roster as-is and revisit after more operator feedback.

recommendation.title: Accept the focused polish
recommendation.body: Implement the requested Sessions roster and drawer changes in the existing Control UI view, style, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the recent Sessions page UI direction in merged history and authored the linked redesign work.
